definition: SAP's master data governance software. By the vendor's description, it is the governance layer for an enterprise's business data, unifying master data, policy and metadata.
SAP's enterprise resource planning (ERP) system. By the vendor's description, it is a modular ERP for an enterprise's core business processes.
Salesforce's customer relationship management (CRM) platform. By the vendor's description, it helps companies connect with their customers.

ION's commodities trading and risk management system for liquid hydrocarbon companies, such as refiners and fuel marketers. By the vendor's description, it covers the work from front to back and is strongest in scheduling, logistics and operations.
Profisee's master data management (MDM) platform. By the vendor's description, it cleans, unifies and improves the quality of an enterprise's critical data across its systems.
LexisNexis Risk Solutions' compliance screening software, Bridger Insight XG. By the vendor's description, it automates account screening for regulatory compliance and reduces false positives.

EMK3's software for energy companies, EMK3 Senergy. By the vendor's description, it covers marketing, transportation and midstream work for companies that produce, gather, transport, process and market oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids.

Quorum Software's hydrocarbon measurement software, FLOWCAL. By the vendor's description, it manages gas and liquid hydrocarbon measurement data across upstream, midstream and distribution operations.
Gravitate's software for fuel operations. By the vendor's description, it optimizes supply, pricing, freight and dispatch in real time for fuel operators.
SAP's data quality software, SAP Information Steward. By the vendor's description, it supports data profiling and monitoring and information policy management.
LenelS2's physical access control system, OnGuard, a Honeywell brand. By the vendor's description, it is an integrated and customizable security management system.
Sirion's contract lifecycle management software. By the vendor's description, it uses AI to manage an enterprise's contracts and get the most value from its relationships.
Thomson Reuters' tax engine, ONESOURCE Determination. By the vendor's description, it calculates sales and use tax, excise tax, VAT and GST.

Software from Quorum Software, a vendor of software for energy companies; which Quorum product it is is not known. By the vendor's description, its software connects energy workflows from the field to the boardroom.
note: Which Quorum product this is stays open (the decision owner, 2026-10-24); the definition is at vendor level (EPM-DEC-001-0099).

definition: An MPC in-house application used by the Commercial organization. It gets all of its data from RightAngle and is almost a replica of it.
note: Terminal Upload sends KittyHawk cross-reference customer ID mappings directly, as the decision owner's input shows; KittyHawk's customer data itself comes from RightAngle (EPM-DEC-001-0099).

definition: Marketing Applications Graphical Interface for Clients: an MPC-built integration that sets up new customer accounts. When SAP MDG creates a customer, MAGIC assigns the SAP MDG customer number and the KittyHawk territory manager to the account in Salesforce, and converts the prospect into a customer account. Every day it syncs the customer's number, name, address, FEIN, status, credit monitor and territory manager to Salesforce.
An MPC-built application that derives operational decisions for a customer, such as locks and limits, from the customer data RightAngle sends it.
note: Thin: a fuller description, such as whether it also allocates product, waits for its owners (EPM-DEC-001-0099).
